note: Greenup County parcels are published only through the PVA's Schneider qPublic viewer (HTTP 403 to automated access, no public REST service). The state kygisserver has only a Webster County PVA parcel service, KYTC's PVA list has no Greenup parcel layer, and the only ArcGIS parcel layers for Greenup are small city-level consultant subsets (Flatwoods 627 and Raceland 190 parcels), not county-wide tax parcels.
